versions.changelog: Optional KEV/NVD refresh of the VMSA catalog (advisories update/show): KEV flags only added, fixed builds never from refresh, reports show when KEV was checked
VMSA known-vulnerability check (vmsa-advisories): ESXi and vCenter builds vs an offline advisory catalog, three-state results, vCenter collector, CSV report with unknowns
17 more host/VM attributes collected: 71 rules now evaluate (was 38); some previously compliant results become violations or undetermined; impossible enum comparisons are undetermined
Roles for network callers (HLD §18): declares role metadata so vmware-policy 1.24.0 can limit each token to a role's tools and targets.
mcp --transport https: serve MCP over HTTPS with bearer tokens (HLD §16)
mcp --expose read / --allow-write: offer only read tools plus chosen write tools
collectors extra admits the 2.0 skills (vmware-aiops / vmware-storage < 3.0)
Docs: one consistent account of what apply does (saves a pending pilot workflow; runs nothing)
MCP instructions now name the configured targets and how to choose one; a config that cannot be read says so instead of falling silent.
One failing collector no longer throws away the scan; drift never reports what it did not read
CLI reads are audited under their MCP tool names; every CLI command declares what it reaches (needs vmware-policy 1.15.0)
Reports, drift and MCP list tools name the snapshot they read and warn when later scans of the target failed.
Every shipped launch path installs the collectors extra, so a plugin, uvx or container install can actually scan; VMWARE_HARDEN_DB now moves the Twin database as the docs always said it did.
fix: run the suite on a non-UTF-8 machine, and stop one skill answering for another
Second-round fixes from the 2026-08-30 VCF 9.1 re-test; vmware-policy floor raised to 1.11.0 (the engine no longer fails open when rules.yaml cannot be read).
Parameter descriptions now reach the MCP JSON schema (0% -> 100% coverage); additionalProperties closed; vmware-policy floor raised to 1.10.0.

Unreachable hosts no longer produce fabricated HIGH violations from cached settings; scan_target no longer writes to the MCP stdio channel; doctor checks targets, connectivity and auth; the collector install instruction now works when followed.

NTP, SSH and firewall state are collected now, so 9 rules across CIS, BSI IT-Grundschutz, 等保 2.0 and PCI-DSS moved from 'cannot be evaluated' to judged. A fact that cannot be read is still omitted, never defaulted.
Collector-dependency and collector errors arrived under a Rich traceback instead of as one line; the CLI now has a main() wrapper. Ctrl+C exits 130 cleanly.
Fixes the server's self-reported version and the advertised tool count; adds a Claude Code plugin manifest.
合规判定诚实化:76/99 条规则此前静默报「合规」。新增 coverage(evaluated/undetermined)贯穿 CLI/report/MCP/web;空违规列表不再等于合规。修好 9 条规则、SQL 内省改用 DuckDB AST、50 处 CAST→TRY_CAST。破坏性:report --format json 改为对象。

vSphere 9 STIG-aligned baseline (EXPERIMENTAL/collector-pending) + STIG advanced-settings host collector + list_stig_controls/describe_stig_content_sync (6→8). ACC has no public API — harden keeps its own engine.
Moved to vmware-skills GitHub org; MCP Registry namespace → io.github.vmware-skills. Links updated.
Repair the live-scan collectors (fabricated import paths → real inventory functions + connection + id/name); remove read-only switch and approval tiers.
A failure that is returned is now audited as a failure, and certificate/URL detail no longer reaches the agent. Both fixes v1.8.4 announced were incomplete.
Teaching error messages, domain exceptions no longer redacted on the way to the agent, and tool descriptions that state when to use each tool and what to call next.
Family version alignment; the credential env-var override lands in the skills that have per-target credentials
MCP server moved into the package namespace — fixes two skills in one environment silently overwriting each other's server; agent-guardrails.md for local/small models now ships in every skill
Read-only mode now documented on every surface that teaches it (SKILL.md, setup-guide, capabilities) and reported by doctor

Read-only mode verified at start-up (6/6 tools read), declared environments; new 'vmware-harden mcp' subcommand so MCP clients need not go through uvx; RELEASE_NOTES no longer claims a config.yaml switch this package lacks
family version alignment (no code change)
Family version alignment to 1.7.4 (substantive change this cycle is in vmware-monitor: host-check boundary read batching).
Family version alignment (v1.7.3)
Bound list_violations output with pagination envelope
Family version alignment with v1.7.1 (AIops/Monitor large-inventory scale fix, issue #31).
vSphere 9 baselines (cis-esxi-9.0, scg-v9)
v1.6.1 family version alignment
v1.6.0 trust architecture: undo tokens + governance harness (budget/audit/risk-tiers)
v1.5.39: AIops snapshot-delete async + honest timeout (token-burn fix), Storage browse timeout fix; others version-aligned
backlog finish: collector de-duplication
backlog: batched writes, dead-schema cleanup, offline evals
compliance-correctness fixes: scoping, severity, approval gate
Security hardening: safe error handling, TLS/path/permission fixes
v1.5.32: family version alignment + test hygiene
v1.5.30: Glama TDQS tool description quality rewrite
Doctor command full synopsis; Smithery/Container deployment; Python 3.10 troubleshooting; v1.5.19 index+LEFT JOIN performance notes

Fix subclass() arg 1 must be a class in goose/old-mcp environments. v1.5.25-1.5.27 only addressed PEP 604 X|None -> Optional[X] but kept 'from __future__ import annotations'; under mcp 1.10-1.13 FastMCP's issubclass() on string annotations crashed server load. This release removes the future import. CLAUDE.md pitfall #33 updated.
Loosen Python requirement to >= 3.10 (was >=3.11). v1.5.25/26 PEP 604 fix already enables 3.10 at runtime; this release lifts pip download/install block.
MCP server Python 3.10 compatibility (踩坑 #33): PEP 604 X|None → Optional[X] in tool signatures; mcp_cmd Python version guard; mcp[cli]>=1.10
VCF 9.0 / 9.1 compatibility declared. README version-compat tables updated. Added Official Broadcom References (VCF Python SDK, REST APIs, CLI tools).
